fullDescription: Warm sunrise light startup-website landing page: cream base with a peach-to-rose sunrise gradient, deep plum ink text, Plus Jakarta Sans, a floating pill sticky nav, gradient-clipped headline word, waitlist email CTA, an elevated prompt preview card with floating chips and a spinning copy ring, feature + template + testimonial sections, and a full-bleed sunrise CTA.
prompt:
## Resumo
A warm, optimistic 'sunrise' startup-website landing page (light) for an AI website-builder product. Cream base (#fff6ef) with a peach-to-rose sunrise gradient, deep plum ink text, and a single waitlist CTA. Built on Tailwind (CDN) with Plus Jakarta Sans. Layout: a floating pill sticky nav, a centered hero with a gradient-clipped headline word, an email waitlist form, a soft elevated 'prompt' preview card with floating chips and a slow-spinning decorative copy ring, a logo trust strip, a 3-up feature grid plus a wide 2-up feature row (one sunrise-gradient card), a rounded template-picker band with 4 swatch cards, a 3-up testimonial grid, a full-bleed sunrise-gradient CTA block with a second waitlist form, and a 4-column footer.

## Estilo Visual
Design in a warm sunrise light style. Palette (Tailwind custom theme): ink #2c1d2e (primary text), inksoft #6b5566 (secondary text), peach #ffb88c, rose #ff7eb3, rosedeep #b32d68, cream #fff6ef (page background), blush #ffe7df. Core gradients: sunrise text fill linear-gradient(100deg,#b32d68 0%,#e8567f 40%,#ff7eb3 78%,#ff9a8b 100%) clipped to text; sunrise solid fill linear-gradient(120deg,#ffb88c 0%,#ff9a8b 50%,#ff7eb3 100%) for the logo mark, accent blocks and swatches; primary button fill linear-gradient(120deg,#a3245c 0%,#b32d68 42%,#c23a6e 82%,#e8567f 100%) so white labels clear >=5:1; a warm dark scrim linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(60,15,40,0.60),rgba(60,15,40,0.55),rgba(60,15,40,0.52)) behind white copy on gradient blocks. Font: Plus Jakarta Sans (Google Fonts; weights 400-800 plus italic 500); headings extrabold with tight tracking, body medium. Shapes: fully-rounded pills for all buttons/badges; large rounded cards (rounded-[26px] nav, [28px] hero card, [34px] template band, [36px] CTA, rounded-3xl/2xl feature/swatch cards) on translucent white/cream with thin rose rings (ring-rose/12 to /20). Effects: card-elev shadow (inset white top highlight + warm plum drop shadow), btn-elev (rose glow), ring-soft (subtle), a faint paper grain (radial rgba(120,40,80,0.05) 1px dots on 22px grid), a multi-stop radial 'hero-glow' behind the hero, and a slow 38s spinning SVG textPath ring of decorative copy. Mood: warm, friendly, optimistic, founder-facing; never cold blue, never neon, never corporate-gray. Respect prefers-reduced-motion (disable the spin).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
A fixed top floating nav (z-50) inset 4 from the top: a max-w-6xl rounded-[26px] bar with translucent white (bg-white/70) + backdrop-blur-xl and a thin ring-rose/15 with the soft ring shadow. Left: a sunrise-gradient rounded-xl badge holding a white ph:sun-horizon-fill icon plus the extrabold 'Lumen' wordmark. Center (hidden below md): pill text links Features / Templates / Customers / Pricing in inksoft that get a blush/70 hover background. Right: a 'Sign in' ghost pill (hidden on the smallest screens), a solid sunrise-gradient 'Get early access' pill with a ph:sparkle-fill icon, and (below md) a circular hamburger button (ph:list-bold) that toggles a slide-down mobile menu panel of the same links.

### Hero
A centered hero section over a multi-stop radial 'hero-glow' (peach/rose washes from the top) with a faint dot grain overlay and, on lg, a slow 38s-spinning decorative SVG textPath ring ('describe your startup . pick a vibe . ship a site by sunrise .') in muted rose at low opacity on the left. Content (max-w-6xl, pt-36): a white/80 pill eyebrow with a sunrise dot and ph:arrow-right-bold ('New: prompt-to-page for founders'); a huge extrabold headline up to ~4.6rem ('Launch a startup site / before your coffee cools.') where 'before your coffee' is the sunrise-gradient-clipped text; a max-w-xl inksoft sub-paragraph; an inline waitlist form (max-w-md, stacks on mobile) = a rounded-full white email input with a ph:envelope-simple leading icon plus a solid sunrise-button pill 'Join the waitlist' with a ph:sun-horizon-fill icon; microcopy 'Free while in beta . no credit card . 2,400 founders already in line'. Below, a max-w-3xl elevated preview card: a rounded-[28px] translucent-white outer with a rounded-[20px] blush->white inner showing a 'Prompt' label (ph:chat-circle-dots-fill), an example prompt sentence, and a row of pill tags (Hero + waitlist / 3 feature cards / Testimonials / a sunrise 'Building 8 sections...' pill). Two floating white chip cards rotate slightly off the card corners ('On-brand palette' with ph:palette-fill, 'Live in 40s' with ph:lightning-fill), hidden on mobile.

### Trust strip
Centered below the hero: an uppercase wide-tracked inksoft label 'Trusted by founders building at', then a wrap of 5 extrabold faux-logo wordmarks (Verdant, Zest, Frequency, Northbound, Lattice), each prefixed by a small Phosphor icon (ph:leaf-fill, ph:orange-slice-fill, ph:waveform-bold, ph:rocket-launch-fill, ph:cube-fill) in inksoft.

### Features
A features section (max-w-6xl, py-24+). Left-aligned intro block (max-w-2xl): a rosedeep uppercase wide-tracked eyebrow ('Why founders pick Lumen'), an extrabold ~2.6rem heading ('Everything between idea and live URL, in one warm canvas.'), and an inksoft sub-paragraph. Then a 3-up card grid (md:3): each rounded-3xl white card with ring-rose/12 and card-elev lifts on hover (-translate-y-1); card 1 has a sunrise-gradient rounded-2xl icon tile (white ph:magic-wand-fill), cards 2-3 use a blush tile with rose/peach icons (ph:swatches-fill, ph:cloud-arrow-up-fill); each has an extrabold title and inksoft body. Below, a wide 2-up row (lg grid-cols-[1.3fr_1fr]): the left card is a full sunrise-gradient block with a warm dark scrim, a blurred white glow blob, a ph:infinity-bold icon, white heading/body ('Edit on an infinite canvas') and 3 dark/20 pill chips; the right is a white card (blush icon tile, ph:plugs-connected-fill, 'Lives in your tools') with a rose 'See the integrations' arrow link that widens its gap on hover.

### Templates band
A templates section holding a single rounded-[34px] panel with a blush->cream->white vertical gradient, ring-rose/12 and card-elev. Centered intro (max-w-2xl): rosedeep eyebrow ('Starting points'), an extrabold ~2.4rem heading ('Pick a sunrise, then make it yours'), inksoft sub. Below, a 4-up swatch-card grid (sm:2 / lg:4): each rounded-2xl white card with ring-rose/12 + ring-soft, a 24-tall rounded swatch on top (one full sunrise-gradient, the others peach->blush, rose->peach, and blush->peach->rose gradients), an extrabold title (Waitlist launch / Seed raise / Hiring page / Product launch) and a tiny inksoft caption; cards lift on hover.

### Testimonials
A testimonials section (max-w-6xl). Centered intro: rosedeep eyebrow ('Founder love') and an extrabold ~2.6rem heading ('The site was live before standup.'). A 3-up grid (md:3) of rounded-3xl white quote cards (ring-rose/12, card-elev, flex-col): each has a row of 5 rose ph:star-fill icons, a medium ink blockquote, and a figcaption = a circular monogram avatar (sunrise-gradient / peach / rose backgrounds with white initial) plus a bold name and an inksoft role (Maya Okafor - Verdant, Leo Vance - Zest, Priya Nair - Frequency).

### CTA block
A full-bleed CTA section: a rounded-[36px] sunrise-gradient block (px-16 py-20) with a warm dark scrim, two large blurred white glow blobs in opposite corners, and centered white content: a black/20 pill badge with ph:sun-horizon-fill ('Free while in beta'), an extrabold up-to-5xl headline ('Your startup deserves a sunrise launch.'), a max-w-md sub, a second waitlist form (rounded-full white email input + a solid INK pill button 'Claim my spot' with ph:arrow-right-bold), and microcopy 'No credit card . cancel anytime . built for founders'.

### Footer
A cream footer with a top rose/12 border. A max-w-6xl grid (md grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr_1fr_1fr]): first column = the sunrise-badge 'Lumen' wordmark, a short inksoft description, and three circular white social buttons (ph:x-logo-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:youtube-logo-bold) that turn rose on hover; three link columns (Product / Company / Resources) with uppercase wide-tracked ink headings and inksoft links hovering to rose. A top-bordered bottom bar splits the copyright ('(c) 2026 Lumen Labs. Made warm in San Francisco.') from Privacy / Terms / Security links.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Floating pill sticky nav: a translucent-white blurred rounded-[26px] bar that floats inset from the top, with a slide-down mobile menu toggled by a hamburger below md

### Componente
Sunrise gradient system: one gradient family reused four ways - background-clipped to the headline emphasis word, as a solid fill for the logo/accent blocks/swatches, as a deep-plum-weighted primary button fill (tuned for >=5:1 white-on-fill contrast), and as monogram avatar backgrounds

### Componente
Warm dark scrim: a uniform deep rose-plum overlay laid behind white copy on every sunrise-gradient block so text clears contrast across the whole peach->rose run

### Componente
Elevated 'prompt' preview card: a rounded-[28px] translucent card with a blush->white inner showing a mock prompt + tag pills, with two slightly-rotated floating white chip cards on its corners

### Componente
Decorative spinning copy ring: an SVG <textPath> on a circular path animated to rotate 360deg over 38s (disabled under prefers-reduced-motion), echoing the reference

### Componente
Layered warm effects: card-elev (inset white top highlight + warm plum drop shadow), btn-elev (rose glow), ring-soft, a radial-dot paper grain, and a multi-stop radial hero-glow

### Componente
Phosphor (Iconify ph:*) icons throughout: sun-horizon, sparkle, list, envelope-simple, chat-circle-dots, palette, lightning, magic-wand, swatches, cloud-arrow-up, infinity, plugs-connected, arrow-right, star, plus social logos

### Componente
Two waitlist email-capture forms (hero + CTA) as the single conversion action, fully-rounded inputs and pill submit buttons

## Notas Especiais
Font loaded from Google Fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans (weights 400-800 plus italic 500); fallback system-ui, sans-serif. Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme palette (ink #2c1d2e, inksoft #6b5566, peach #ffb88c, rose #ff7eb3, rosedeep #b32d68, cream #fff6ef, blush #ffe7df). Icons via Iconify (code.iconify.design, ph:* Phosphor set). All imagery is pure CSS gradient (no photos): the swatches, glow blobs and grain are gradients/SVG only. body background is cream #fff6ef; html scroll-behavior:smooth. The contrast-critical detail: the primary button gradient is weighted toward deep rose/plum (#a3245c->#e8567f) and white copy on gradient blocks sits over a warm dark scrim, so white text stays >=4.5:1 everywhere. Keep the mood warm, friendly and optimistic - never cold blue, neon, or corporate-gray; one clear waitlist CTA, no pricing table.
